findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_ast_symbol_graph" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "context-code-solver" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prune_context_skeleton, isolate_stacktrace_root_cause, compile_polyglot_type_schemas · Private data: diff_agent_memory_checkpoint, prune_context_skeleton, plan_context_token_budget, rerank_hybrid_rag_chunks, apply_fuzzy_code_patch, analyze_ast_symbol_graph, audit_module_dependency_cycles, isolate_stacktrace_root_cause, schedule_critical_path_tasks · Public sink: compile_polyglot_type_schemas · Destructive: evaluate_deterministic_math.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prune_context_skeleton, isolate_stacktrace_root_cause, compile_polyglot_type_schemas · Private data: diff_agent_memory_checkpoint, prune_context_skeleton, plan_context_token_budget, rerank_hybrid_rag_chunks, apply_fuzzy_code_patch, analyze_ast_symbol_graph, audit_module_dependency_cycles, isolate_stacktrace_root_cause, schedule_critical_path_tasks · Public sink: compile_polyglot_type_schemas · Destructive: evaluate_deterministic_math

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
